title: Workflows
description: A workflow connects agents into a pipeline. Each agent receives the results of its predecessors.
emptyText: Choose how you want to start. You can also look at the examples below right away.
duplicate: Duplicate: creates a copy without runs
descriptionHint: Optional. What is the workflow for?
starterNote: The workflow starts with Start, one agent and Result. You can change everything in the editor.
deleteText: “{{name}}” will be deleted. Previous runs are kept under Runs.
createMode: How do you want to start?
aiDescriptionHint: The Workflow Architect plans the agents, configures and connects them and shows you the draft before anything is saved. The name is optional.

start.label: Start new
start.aiText: Describe what the workflow should do. The Workflow Architect designs agents and flow; you review the draft before it is saved. This uses model calls.
start.exampleText: Look at ready-made workflows with synthetic test data and copy one as your own. No model call.
start.manualText: Starts with an input, an empty agent and a result. You drag further building blocks onto the canvas.
